front.title: Per-Entry Soft-State Refresh Horizon and Paced Fragmentation Scheduling for Fast Network Notification (FANN) Telemetry

abstract.t: This document specifies a Standards Track per-entry soft-state refresh horizon profile, a bounded multi-packet fragmentation scheduling invariant, and a YANG 1.1 data model (ietf-fann-soft- state-refresh) for Fast Network Notification (FANN) link-quality telemetry. To prevent unrefreshed link entries from persisting indefinitely when partial event-triggered updates share a transport channel with periodic full sweeps, each receiver maintains an independent monotonic receipt horizon per six-tuple link-record key. Furthermore, when a full periodic sweep spans F fragmented datagrams paced at inter-packet interval T_spacing, the refresh period T_refresh and expiration horizon T_expire satisfy T_refresh <= T_expire - M - (F - 1) * T_spacing.MUST NOT reset the full-sweep periodic timer for omitted records. The refresh bound explicitly accounts for multi-packet fragmentation emission duration (T_refresh <= T_expire - M - (F - 1) * T_spacing).
